title: Funding Models for Education and Training Programmes for Singaporeans
what_it_is: Funding Models for Education and Training Programmes for Singaporeans

sections.label: Education and training funding models
sections.summary: A question asks whether the Government will review funding models for education and training, and describes PET and CET.

sentences.speaker: Mr Saktiandi Supaat
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Education (a) whether the Government will review the funding models for education and training programmes for Singaporeans; (b) whether the current funding model is optimal and effective (i) by classifying Continuing Education and Training (CET) and Pre-employment Training (PET) separately and (ii) in supporting the Skills Future and lifelong learning efforts; and (c) whether there are different values attached to CET and PET programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: It is a formative experience, to equip our young with a meaningful and carefully designed body of knowledge and skills, to help them become independent, contributing members of society.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The focus is on values, civic consciousness, foundational skills like literacy and numeracy, and certain domain expertise to kickstart a career and a journey of lifelong learning.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Continuing Education and Training (CET), often referred to as training, is to build upon PET, to upgrade skills and knowledge, keep up with technology and changes in the industry, or even to pick up another set of domain expertise.

sections.label: SkillsFuture and Adapt and Grow subsidies
sections.summary: The SkillsFuture Mid-Career Enhanced Subsidy gives up to 90% subsidy for Singaporeans aged 40 and above, and Professional Conversion Programmes give up to 90% training and salary support.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: For example, we have the SkillsFuture Mid-Career Enhanced Subsidy which provides up to 90% subsidy for Singaporeans aged 40 and above.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: And, in addition, mid-career individuals who wish to reskill and switch careers can tap on the Professional Conversion Programmes under the Adapt and Grow initiative, which provides training and salary support of up to 90% to the employers for the duration of the training.

sections.label: CET subsidies up to 70%
sections.summary: CET provides generous subsidies of up to 70% even outside enhanced programmes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: CET, even if you do not do it as part of one of these enhanced programmes, we still provide generous subsidies of up to 70%.

sections.label: Calibrating funding by individual needs
sections.summary: Funding is focused on workers switching careers or displaced, and calibrated depending on competing needs of different individuals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: So, it depends on where you want to put your resources into.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: And in our case, a decision has been taken to, say, let us focus on helping workers who need to go through training because they are switching careers or they are displaced from their original jobs, to look for a new job.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: We also want to look at how to help people who want to upgrade their skills, say, they have a National ITE Certificate (Nitec) or Higher Nitec, and they are going for a polytechnic diploma.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: For someone who is going for something that actually benefits an individual more, for example, if you are going for postgraduate degrees or you are going for your second or third degree, it is not that we do not fund you, but I think the funding will have to be calibrated, depending on the competing needs for different groups of individuals.
